ayahs.ar: وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَرْوًا ۝١ۙ
ayahs.tr: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

ayahs.ar: فَالْحٰمِلٰتِ وِقْرًا ۝٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

ayahs.ar: فَالْجٰرِيٰتِ يُسْرًا ۝٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: And those [ships] sailing with ease

ayahs.ar: فَالْمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمْرًا ۝٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لَصَادِقٌ ۝٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

ayahs.ar: وَّاِنَّ الدِّيْنَ لَوَاقِعٌ ۝٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

ayahs.ar: وَالسَّمَا࢜ءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ ۝٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: By the heaven containing pathways,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكُمْ لَفِيْ قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ ۝٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ الْخَرّٰصُوْنَ ۝١٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: Destroyed are the falsifiers

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ فِيْ غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُوْنَ ۝١١ۙ
ayahs.tr: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

ayahs.ar: يَسْـَٔلُوْنَ اَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّيْنِ ۝١٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَي النَّارِ يُفْتَنُوْنَ ۝١٣
ayahs.tr: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

ayahs.ar: ذُوْقُوْا فِتْنَتَكُمْؕ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۝١٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

ayahs.ar: اٰخِذِيْنَ مَا͏ٓ اٰتٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِيْنَ ۝١٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

ayahs.ar: كَانُوْا قَلِيْلًا مِّنَ الَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُوْنَ ۝١٧
ayahs.tr: They used to sleep but little of the night,

ayahs.ar: وَبِالْاَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

ayahs.ar: وَفِيْٓ اَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّا࢜ىِٕلِ وَالْمَحْرُوْمِ ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

ayahs.ar: وَفِي الْاَرْضِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلْمُوْقِنِيْنَ ۝٢٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

ayahs.ar: وَفِيْٓ اَنْفُسِكُمْؕ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

ayahs.ar: وَفِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.tr: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَا࢜ءِ وَالْاَرْضِ اِنَّهٗ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَا͏ٓ اَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ۝٢٣ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

ayahs.ar: هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيْثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ الْمُكْرَمِيْنَ ۝٢٤ۘ
ayahs.tr: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

ayahs.ar: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌۚ قَوْمٌ مُّنْكَرُوْنَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.tr: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ اِلٰٓي اَهْلِهٖ فَجَا࢜ءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِيْنٍ ۝٢٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَّبَهٗٓ اِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ اَلَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ ۝٢٧ؗ
ayahs.tr: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

ayahs.ar: فَاَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيْفَةًؕ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْؕ وَبَشَّرُوْهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيْمٍ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

ayahs.ar: فَاَقْبَلَتِ امْرَاَتُهٗ فِيْ صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوْزٌ عَقِيْمٌ ۝٢٩
ayahs.tr: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا كَذٰلِكِۙ قَالَ رَبُّكِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْعَلِيْمُ ۝٣٠
ayahs.tr: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۝٣١
ayahs.tr: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا͏ٓ اُرْسِلْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِيْنَ ۝٣٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

ayahs.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّنْ طِيْنٍ ۝٣٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: To send down upon them stones of clay,

ayahs.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِيْنَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.tr: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيْهَا مِنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٣٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيْهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ ۝٣٦ۚ
ayahs.tr: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيْهَا͏ٓ اٰيَةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ يَخَافُوْنَ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَ ۝٣٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَفِيْ مُوْسٰٓي اِذْ اَرْسَلْنٰهُ اِلٰي فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝٣٨
ayahs.tr: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي بِرُكْنِهٖ وَقَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌ ۝٣٩
ayahs.tr: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذْنٰهُ وَجُنُوْدَهٗ فَنَبَذْنٰهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيْمٌ ۝٤٠ؕ
ayahs.tr: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

ayahs.ar: وَفِيْ عَادٍ اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيْحَ الْعَقِيْمَ ۝٤١ۚ
ayahs.tr: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

ayahs.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيْمِ ۝٤٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

ayahs.ar: وَفِيْ ثَمُوْدَ اِذْ قِيْلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوْا حَتّٰي حِيْنٍ ۝٤٣
ayahs.tr: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

ayahs.ar: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.tr: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَّمَا كَانُوْا مُنْتَصِرِيْنَ ۝٤٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوْحٍ مِّنْ قَبْلُؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِيْنَ ۝٤٦ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: وَالسَّمَا࢜ءَ بَنَيْنٰهَا بِاَيْىدٍ وَّاِنَّا لَمُوْسِعُوْنَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.tr: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

ayahs.ar: وَالْاَرْضَ فَرَشْنٰهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمٰهِدُوْنَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.tr: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.tr: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.

ayahs.ar: فَفِرُّوْٓا اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٥٠ۚ
ayahs.tr: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَؕ اِنِّيْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٥١
ayahs.tr: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ مَا͏ٓ اَتَي الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌ ۝٥٢ۚ
ayahs.tr: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

ayahs.ar: اَتَوَاصَوْا بِهٖۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَ ۝٥٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ بِمَلُوْمٍ ۝٥٤ࣗؗ
ayahs.tr: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.

ayahs.ar: وَّذَكِّرْ فَاِنَّ الذِّكْرٰي تَنْفَعُ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.tr: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْاِنْسَ اِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوْنِ ۝٥٦
ayahs.tr: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

ayahs.ar: مَا͏ٓ اُرِيْدُ مِنْهُمْ مِّنْ رِّزْقٍ وَّمَا͏ٓ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّطْعِمُوْنِ ۝٥٧
ayahs.tr: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِيْنُ ۝٥٨
ayahs.tr: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا ذَنُوْبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوْبِ اَصْحٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُوْنِ ۝٥٩
ayahs.tr: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ يَّوْمِهِمُ الَّذِيْ يُوْعَدُوْنَ ۝٦٠ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
